newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: KAGISO, PERSKOR MERGER TO GO AHEAD.
newsitem.headline: KAGISO, PERSKOR MERGER TO GO AHEAD.

text.p: Publisher Perskorgroep Ltd said on Friday it had reached agreement on a deal to merge with Kagiso Publishers after its minority shareholders approved a new arrangement.
Under the revised scheme, Dagbreek Trust is to accept a lower premium of 1.629 million Perskor Beleggings Ltd shares, against 2.62 million under the original deal.
The deal between Perskor, run by white Afrikaners, and Kagiso, run by blacks, is seen as a major advance for black empowerment in the publishing sector.

Control of Perskor, which owns the daily Citizen newspaper and 23 regional titles, will rest in future with a voting pool consisting of three equal shareholders -- Kagiso Trust, Rembrandt Group Ltd and Dagbreek Trust.
